verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs describe a "Deploy Private Models" capability for running your own fine-tuned weights on dedicated A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 instances, with autoscaling and a private endpoint. That covers the core of serving custom weights. The evidence is only landing-page-level, so the upload workflow and any LoRA support are not shown. missing for 10: documented upload/import workflow and supported weight formats, explicit LoRA adapter serving, independent or hands-on corroboration.
